test.name: annex_k_streams_against_their_reference_bitmaps
test.initial_wave75_status: early-returns successfully when corpus missing; wave75 log PASS did not execute corpus comparisons
test.execution: For each case, compare in-process and sandboxed JBIG2 output against a supplied BMP reference; require the two isolations to agree. Cases include whole pages plus Annex H.1 and generic-region subparts.

expectation_semantics.Matches: Must match the reference bitmap; any other outcome is a failure.
expectation_semantics.Departs(clause): Must not match the sample-software reference; a match is a failure. Refusal and any nonmatching decode result are accepted; the test does not require a particular refusal/error outcome.
expectation_semantics.Outside(reason): No match/mismatch/refusal expectation is imposed; the test only requires isolated and sandboxed outcomes to agree.
expectation_semantics.aggregate_print: The reported count is distinct whole-stream inputs for which every Whole case matches; it is not a count of compliant features or a declaration of codec conformance.

interpretation: Seven named departures are case-level guards against copying sample encoder/decoder behavior. The ten-stream Annex K corpus is informative evidence, not a complete T.88 conformance suite. The passing test alone cannot establish whole-reference conformance.
parent_execution: t88-data-wave75.log PASS with actual official dataset:16cases=8Matches+7Departs+1Outside; all seven Departs refused in this run, but assertions allow any nonmatch. Both isolation modes compared;2whole streams match everypage. Not codec certification.
